en: Black‑and‑white image of a broad, quiet residential street lined with early‑20th‑century multi‑storey townhouses and villas. On the left side are ornate houses with steep tiled roofs, dormers, and decorated facades behind wooden fences and trees. On the right side are more uniform, stuccoed apartment houses behind solid masonry fences and gates. There are several tall trees along the sidewalk, utility poles, and early overhead telephone/telegraph lines. A few people in dark clothing walk or stand along the street, and a cyclist is visible further down the road. The street surface appears partly unpaved. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
